bio: Beat Bang Da Hitta of the PBG in prison.
Created the 1212.
After internal conflict, fell out with Hella Bandz members; made a song Fuck Hella Bandz with DMoney.
Had a dispute with Chief Keef over the phrase 'Buk Buk', which he claimed Keef stole from him.
Close to Lamron and the TTE.
Had disputes with Lil Don of Brick$quad 069 and Reggie Baybee of CMB; fought Reggie Baybee.
Incarcerated for a murder he did not commit but never informed on Shawty.
Not the killer of GBE Capo.
In his honor, Lakeside represents him under the name Posto Gang.
A rapper.
Incarcerated for the murder of NLMB MaddMaxx; he was not the shooter but did fire.
From Lake Park (SuWu TTB). Fought with his accomplice Lil Mister in 2018 after personal conflict. His mother and sister were shot at; he hired killers to kill the shooters.

Was close to Poppie and TB of Tyquan World. Killed Millie of Whiz City; was then killed by police next to Millie's body after officers claimed he pointed a gun, though witnesses said he had no weapon.
A rapper close to Mexico.
Along with Lil Jojo, P.Rico, and Smylez (Brick$quad 069), regularly beat Lil Reese of Lamron at school (Robeson). In 2019, he and other Evans Mobb members caught, beat, and robbed Lil Reese.
Also represents the HitzSquad.

In 2014, shot at an enemy of MurdaTown but the bullets hit Lil Boo of the 600. Thinking he was the target, Lil Boo returned with Tay600, D.Rose, Cdai, and RondoNumba9 to retaliate; Cdai, RondoNumba9, and D.Rose killed taxi driver Javan Boyd, who was not from MurdaTown.
Expected to be released soon.
Incarcerated for a shooting after taking charges for his members.
After his death, PocketTown and KTS began representing the MoeBlock.
Was close to Motor of Jaro City.
Called himself Lil Nick of the 600 despite not being a member. Shot in the head in place of Jusblow of the 600 when the MOB caught them together outside a building.
Very close to Lil Scrapp of MOB and paid tribute to him multiple times.
